description: A small label for a status, count or category, with an optional icon.
overview:
`Badge` is a compact pill `View` that passes a small, bold text style and a 12-point icon size to its children. Six variants are available. `default`, `secondary`, `destructive` and `link` show colored text with no background, while `outline` adds a hairline border and `ghost` adds horizontal padding.

Use `default` for highlighted labels, `secondary` for neutral metadata, `destructive` for errors and `outline` when the badge needs a visible edge.
usage:
Put the label in a `Text` and icons in an `Icon`. Use `render` to render the badge as a different component, such as a `Pressable`, while keeping its styles.

`badgeVariants` and `badgeTextVariants` are also exported if you need the classes on another element.

examples.Variants: All six variants side by side.

Badge.render: Element to render instead of the default `View`.

accessibility:
- The badge adds no role; it is read as plain text.
- If you render it as a pressable element, give that element a role and label.
notes: - Text colors come from `text-link`, `text-label-secondary`, `text-danger` and `text-label`; light and dark follow the system appearance.
